findings.passage: As part of the foundation for our Constitutional Republic, the 2nd Amendment states the “right of the people to keep and bear Arms, shall not be infringed.” Many existing gun laws are not being enforced or equally applied, and gun reform has progressively been enacted over many years — most recently with President Trump’s 2017 ban on bump stocks.
findings.note: Her written answer to WDET's 2024 voter-guide question on gun reform, when she was a candidate for the same seat. The page carries an editor's note that the Supreme Court struck down the bump-stock ban in June 2024.
